rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making something physically larger or more intense, and for amplifying a signal.

example.english: My phone can amplify the photo.
example.traditional: 我部手機可以放大張相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 ho2 ji5 fong3 daai6 zoeng1 soeng2

rows.note: Use this with a signal when the focus is on strengthening it rather than describing the technical amplification process.

example.english: This device can amplify the mobile signal.
example.traditional: 呢個裝置可以加強手機訊號。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zong1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gaa1 koeng4 sau2 gei1 seon3 hou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when turning up the loudness of a speaker or audio.

example.english: The TV is too quiet—amplify the sound a bit.
example.traditional: 部電視太細聲，開大聲啲啦。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 si6 taai3 sai3 seng1 hoi1 daai6 seng1 di1 laa1
